entities.summary: Anatoly Vladimirovich Chepiga is a colonel in the Russian General Staff's Main Directorate, the military intelligence service of the Russian Federation. He is reported to have served in the Second Chechen War and the Russo-Ukrainian War. He is known to have operated under the cover names "Ruslan Tabarov" and "Ruslan Boshirov".
